claims.statement: EU Regulation 2025/40 on packaging and packaging waste provides for harmonized labeling and methodologies for identifying packaging material composition and substances of concern using standardized, open digital technologies.

Hypothesis: small brands currently chase packaging evidence through email and spreadsheets and will pay for supplier-linked version control and an exportable evidence pack; the exact Polish implementation burden and timing require validation.

contrary_evidence: Enterprise product-lifecycle and EPR software vendors may move down-market with packaged PPWR modules.
Some micro-brands outsource all packaging compliance to manufacturers and may not be direct buyers.

economics.acquisition_route: Hypothesis: free one-SKU evidence-gap scan, then brand conversion and supplier invitations; EPR advisors receive recurring referral revenue.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Hypothesis: 100 brands in year 2, 700 in year 4, and 1800 Central European brands in year 6 at 1000 PLN blended monthly revenue yields 21.6M PLN ARR. At 3-5x ARR and 55-70% founder ownership, founder equity can exceed 5M PLN once supplier-driven acquisition and retention are demonstrated.
economics.founder_time: Hypothesis: 12-18 hours/week through 10 paid brands, then document review is delegated to trained specialists.
economics.gross_margin_basis: Hypothesis: 78-88% software margin before optional expert review; reviewed exports target 45-60% gross margin.
economics.payback: Hypothesis: 3-6 months at 1500-4000 PLN acquisition cost and 800-1800 PLN monthly revenue per brand.
economics.pricing: Hypothesis: 499-1999 PLN/month by SKU count plus 500-1500 PLN for specialist-reviewed evidence packs.
economics.retention_or_repeat: Hypothesis: recurring SKU and supplier changes, annual evidence refreshes, and retailer requests support target annual logo retention above 85%.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Supplier-linked packaging evidence graph, document-version history, exception patterns, and benchmarked gap-resolution outcomes
fingerprint.customer: Polish D2C cosmetics and supplement brands with 10-500 SKUs and fragmented packaging suppliers
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Every onboarded brand invites packaging suppliers; accounting/EPR consultants and contract manufacturers resell the workspace
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Supplier evidence portal, version graph, gap detection, audit trail, and compliance-readiness benchmark
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: Brand pays per active SKU/supplier workspace and for a reviewed evidence-pack export
fingerprint.problem_trigger: New SKU, packaging change, retailer evidence request, EPR filing, or PPWR readiness review

founder_fit: FMCG context helps understand SKU, supplier, and evidence workflows without using employer-confidential information.
Document extraction and entity resolution fit AI/data skills.
Supplier invitations create product-led distribution rather than founder-led content marketing.
A narrow cosmetics/supplement beachhead is reachable within the capital and time constraints.
risks: Incorrect compliance claims; product must organize evidence, not issue legal clearance without authorized review.
Supplier documents may be outdated, forged, or contractually restricted.
Regulatory simplification could narrow the initial pain.

structure.control_point: versioned packaging evidence graph connecting brands, SKUs, components, and suppliers
structure.critical_dependency: supplier participation and reliable verification of submitted documents

thesis: A supplier-invite evidence graph for small Polish cosmetics and supplement brands that collects packaging composition, declarations, test documents, and version history once and assembles product-level evidence packs and anonymized compliance-readiness benchmarks. Each brand pulls suppliers onto the network, making distribution and data density compound together.
title: PackProof Supplier Evidence Exchange
uncertainties: The minimum evidence set and applicable dates vary by packaging type and delegated acts.
Supplier invitation conversion and document authenticity are untested.
The 55000 PLN capital estimate and every numeric business assumption below are planning hypotheses.
